from collections import deque

INF = float('inf')
shortest = INF

for start in range(n):
    # BFS from start
    dist = [-1]*n
    parent = [-1]*n
    dist[start] = 0
    q = deque([start])
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        for v in adj[u]:
            if dist[v] == -1:
                dist[v] = dist[u] + 1
                parent[v] = u
                q.append(v)
            elif parent[u] != v and parent[v] != u:
                # found a cycle
                cycle_len = dist[u] + dist[v] + 1
                if cycle_len < shortest:
                    shortest = cycle_len
                    print(f"Found cycle length {cycle_len} from {start}: u={u}, v={v}")

    if v == n:
        return True

        return dfs(v+1)
    used = set()
    for u in adj[v]:
        if colors[u] != -1:

    for c in range(5):

            colors[v] = c

    return False
